dedupe_keys.name: spatiotemporal assessment of solar powered ev charging infrastructure a case study of kampala wakiso area in uganda

description: A Makerere University and EPFL team publishes a Kampala–Wakiso case-study package for solar-powered electric-vehicle charging. Zenodo lists one public archive under CC BY 4.0. The provider describes regional boundaries, population raster, workplace and point-of-interest inputs, plus modelled origin-destination travel, charging demand, hourly PV generation and energy-coverage indicators. The study distributes a simulated fleet of 60,000 vehicles among home, workplace and other charging locations. This real-region application can inform charging-site, electricity-demand and solar-integration scenarios in rapidly growing urban areas. No related catalogue case study explicitly covers Kampala–Wakiso. A limitation is that the fleet and its charging patterns are simulated, not 60,000 observed EV users. The landing page does not give calibration errors, grid-connection constraints, year of projected operation or realised infrastructure outcomes. It reports output categories but no final self-sufficiency value in the public summary. The archive was not downloaded, no model was run and no facility was checked on the ground.
name: Spatiotemporal Assessment of Solar Powered EV Charging Infrastructure: A Case Study of Kampala-Wakiso Area in Uganda
